dishes.name: Chestnut black pudding
dishes.desc: Limousin black pudding made with chestnuts, grilled in a pan and served with fried onions and caramelised apples from the region.

dishes.name: Limousin clafoutis
dishes.desc: A batter cake traditionally baked with whole cherries and their pits. Made with other fruit it is called flognarde. The best-known dessert of the Limousin.

dishes.name: Limousin potato pie
dishes.desc: A savory pie of potatoes, sometimes with meat, in a brioche-style crust in Haute-Vienne. Sold warm at the central market and by local bakers.

dishes.name: Galetou
dishes.desc: A rustic buckwheat pancake once used as bread, usually rolled around rillettes or cracklings. Found at the central market in Limoges.

dishes.name: Saint-Léonard marzipan
dishes.desc: Almond, egg white and sugar sweet, crisp and golden outside, soft inside. Made in Saint-Léonard-de-Noblat, near Limoges, and said to have come with pilgrims.
